item.title: Self-Hosted DHCP Lease Management: Kea vs ISC DHCP vs dnsmasq Lease Analysis
item.description: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) is the backbone of network address assignment, but managing DHCP leases at scale requires more than just running a DHCP server. Whether you’re troubleshooting IP conflicts, auditing network usage, or planning capacity expansions, having proper visibility into your DHCP lease database is essential.
